stemMarkdown: A can do a piece of work in 12 days. A and B working together finish it in 8 days. How many days would B alone take? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Together they do $\dfrac{1}{8}$ of the work per day and A alone does $\dfrac{1}{12}$, so B's daily rate is $\dfrac{1}{8} - \dfrac{1}{12} = 0.041667$. B alone needs $24.0$ days.
